player_note: The post's description says: "I blow stuff up with this deck i blew up EPP Han, EPP leia and Ben kenobi witha Bomarr monk at 2 different times at the NYC grand slam". The wiki has no NYC Grand Slam page and Decipher's Grand Slam 2000 list as recorded on the wiki has no New York City event, and the title marks this as v2, so it is filed as a general deck until the event is confirmed.
